component.name: BNK Sound
component.summary: Control PipeWire devices and application volumes

description.p: BNK Sound is a native audio mixer for Wayland and PipeWire. It controls output and input devices, application volumes, mute state, and default devices.
Mixer states can be saved as profiles. Application streams can be pinned to output devices, and supported media players show current MPRIS track information.
